title: Fileflux app icon
brief: Application icon for Fileflux in the Bolt family style (dark palette, info blue and tint, chamfered tiles), folder-based mark distinct from ReqFlux's paper plane and DBFlux's bolt glyph, legible at 16 px. Each artboard shows the icon at 256/64/32/16 on dark and light backgrounds; 32 and 16 use a simplified small variant. RECOMMENDED: 01-chamfer-folder.html (closest to the Bolt shell and in-app folder tiles, strongest 16 px silhouette without leaning on the unapproved cobalt accent).

artboards.title: Chamfer folder (recommended)
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to the Bolt shell and the in-app folder tiles (info blue on panel, chamfered corners); the dark tile is quiet on dark docks and shares the chamfer idea with DBFlux, differing by colour and the folder subject

artboards.title: Cobalt flow
artboards.tradeoff: Strongest family resemblance to ReqFlux (cobalt fill, white glyph) and very legible on any background; least Fileflux-specific colour and it leans on the provisional, unapproved brand accent

artboards.title: Island rows
artboards.tradeoff: Outlined folder with detail rows says 'file explorer' rather than just 'folder' and echoes the 2px tint edge; thin strokes and rows blur at 16 px, so the small variant drops the rows to one bar
